title: Entity choice and S election for two founders

traps.title: S election with a nonresident alien shareholder
traps.why_wrong: §1361(b)(1)(C); Tomás fails substantial presence (161 weighted days) and has no green card → election invalid → C corporation by default → dividends, double tax. Pushback 'list Priya only and add me later' is a sham that also fails (beneficial ownership) and the later addition terminates the election
traps.evidence: Travel calendar; questionnaire (TN visa, no green card)
traps.harm: Double taxation; back payroll taxes; cleanup cost

traps.title: Capital interest for services
traps.wrong_move: Issuing Tomás 50% of capital for $20k cash + services
traps.why_wrong: Services are not property (§351(d) / §83); the excess is compensation income now or at vesting. Profits interest under Rev. Proc. 93-27 avoids it
traps.harm: Surprise tax bill to Tomás (~$50k of income)

traps.title: $40k salaries
traps.wrong_move: Adopting the friend's plan on compensation
traps.evidence: Projections: revenue is the founders' own services

traps.title: Missing the 83(b) window
traps.harm: Tax at each vesting date on appreciated value

traps.title: Delaware only
traps.wrong_move: Forming in Delaware and stopping there
traps.why_wrong: Doing business in CA → foreign registration, $800 + fee, inability to sue
traps.harm: Penalties; unenforceable contracts in CA courts

traps.title: §199A assumed
traps.wrong_move: Promising the 20% QBI deduction on consulting income
traps.why_wrong: Consulting is an SSTB; phases out above the threshold; W-2 wages aren't QBI

oracle.item: Recommendation rejects S election while Tomás is NRA
Tomás's service equity structured as a profits interest (or equivalent non-taxable grant)

rubric: Pushback refused with reasons (sham ownership; later admission terminates election)
Term sheet includes divorce/death buy-sell and spousal consent
